data.name: Grand Opening: The Apothecary
data.detailed_description:
Today is the grand opening of your new apothecary... but the moving company has left every potion, herb, book, and alchemical tool scattered across the floor. Put everything back where it belongs, serve your first customers, and turn opening day into a success.

Set Up Your Apothecary

Restore order one shelf at a time, organize your items how you see fit, purchase storage solutions, and transform the apothecary into a successful cozy shop.

Organize Everything

Sort more than 3,000 handcrafted objects including herbs, ingredients, alchemical tools, books, potions, clothing, and more. Watch the shop slowly come together as empty shelves become beautifully stocked displays.

Serve Your First Customers

Locate the products customers are looking for, keep the shelves organized, and earn gold to expand and improve your growing business.

Relax and Enjoy the Process

Take your time and enjoy the simple satisfaction of putting everything back where it belongs.

There are no time limits, no fail states, and no pressure. Just a warm, cozy atmosphere where every shelf you organize makes the shop feel a little more like home.

Key Features

  • A cozy organizing simulation where you sort more than 3,000 products

  • 10+ item categories including herbs, ingredients, alchemical tools, books, potions, clothing, and more

  • Gameplay focused on serving customers, and using gold to build your shop.

  • The visual satisfaction of watching the store become cleaner and cleaner

  • No time limits and no game over. A relaxed, low-pressure atmosphere you can enjoy at your own pace
